summary: @ornikar/react-modern-calendar-datepicker ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, rotated string arrays) and, when `bun` is not on PATH, downloads a Bun binary for the host platform from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscated `@bun @bun-cjs` payload (rotated string arrays, hex constants, hex-named identifiers) unrelated to the advertised React date-picker functionality and reachable only via this preinstall path. The package presents itself as a fork of the legitimate Kiarash-Z/react-modern-calendar-datepicker React component library, which upstream has no preinstall, no setup.mjs, and no math_init.js — a pure-frontend React component has no legitimate need to fetch a second JavaScript runtime and execute an opaque compiled blob at install time. The alternate-runtime download from an official host is used here to run non-official, author-supplied obfuscated code, yielding arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
